/- --------------------------------------------------------------
           Lipschitz
-------------------------------------------------------------- -/

def isLipschitz (f : ℝ → ℝ) (L : ℝ) : Prop :=
    ∀ (x:ℝ) (y: ℝ), |f x - f y| ≤ L * |x-y|

#check abs_mul

theorem ex1 : isLipschitz (fun x => 2 * x) 2 := by
  intro x y
  simp only
  have h: 2*x - 2*y = 2*(x-y) := by ring
  rw [h]
  simp [abs_mul]
